messages:
Vik: Kicking off bring-up for nebula-lite-v3 q5 on staging. Quick smoke shows odd punctuation glue when outputs mix Han and Arabic. Sharing minimal repro + logs.
Soojin: paste sample please
Vik: SAMPLE:
```
INPUT: "今日は the meeting with الفرق started"
EXPECTED (fp16): "今日は the meeting with الفرق started"  (space between Han and Arabic)
FP16 OUTPUT: "今日は the meeting with الفرق started"
Q5 OUTPUT: "今日は the meeting withالفرق started"  <-- no separator, punctuation attached to Han
```
Marcos: Token-level diff? detok?
Vik: Ran token id diff for that sample; tokenization identical. Looks like detok postprocess using locale profiles went to generic join. Also seeing a measured metric hit on our mixed-orientation eval: zh->ar BLEU -1.4, "separator-rate" down from 0.982 -> 0.915 on q5.
Yuki: Any errors in logs?
Vik: Logs from staging canary nebula-lite-v3@b7a9c: 
```
2026-04-12T11:02:12Z nebula-init: tokenizer v2 loaded
2026-04-12T11:02:12Z quant-bootstrap: q5 kernels online
2026-04-12T11:02:12Z profile-loader: open('/opt/redwood/profiles/locale_profiles.json') -> OK
2026-04-12T11:02:12Z detok: profile loaded
2026-04-12T11:02:12Z detok: fast-check enabled
2026-04-12T11:02:12Z detok: fast-check invariant failed for sample 102 -> using fallback simple-join
```
Soojin: So profile is present; fallback implies the fast detok path is choosing simple-join for some reason. Could be a bug in fast-path logic under q5 quant layout.
Marcos: We recently changed the fast-path to use a compressed lookup table that the quant runtime maps differently. If table indices shift, adjacency checks could misfire.
Yuki: Action plan: 1) flip off fast-path in q5 canary (FLAG_DETOK_FAST=0) 2) add a pre-rollout smoke that evaluates 2k mixed-orient examples and asserts separator-rate within 98% of fp16 baseline and BLEU drop < 0.5 3) add a unit test that runs the fast-path adjacency lookup on corner cases (Han + Arabic punctuation).
Vik: I'll open PR to disable fast-path by default for nebula q5 canary and add the smoke job.
Soojin: Also add an infra check: ensure compressed lookup table produced during build has deterministic checksum and is validated at startup. If checksum mismatch, refuse fast-path.
Marcos: Good idea. I'll add a startup check in the fast-path loader.
qa-bot: CI job queued: ci/nebula-detok-smoke/q5-2026-04-12 #3010. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3010 :hourglass: 
Vik: Creating ticket ML-4012 with failing sample ids and diffs for tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-4012
Soojin: Until smoke passes, pause wide rollout and keep canary limited. Also add the separator-rate metric to the bring-up dashboard so we catch regressions earlier.
Marcos: Will push the checksum validation and unit test. Requesting expedited review.
Vik: Thanks — will post CI outcome here when detok-smoke finishes. :thumbsup:
